messages:
leo: Payment processor sent back CAIQ asking for explicit per-tenant BYOK support on Dedicated + confirmation that audit logs show key usage. They want wording we can include in contract.

nina: Short answer: Dedicated supports customer-managed key material in specific network-isolated Dedicated clusters. Private/on-prem supports full BYOK. Hosted does NOT support tenant BYOK today.

leo: Can we phrase it as contractual statement? Customer asked: "Who rotates keys?" and "Can Redwood fallback to its keys automatically?"

ops-bot: OpsReminder: BYOK onboarding requires SR-3 security checklist and HSM attestation for on-prem. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-onboard.md

sales-eng: Draft CAIQ language suggestion: ""Redwood supports customer-managed key material for Dedicated clusters on an opt-in basis; rotation of customer key material is performed by the customer's KMS. Emergency fallback to Redwood-managed keys is available only if an explicit escrow addendum is executed in the contract; fallback is not automatic."" Short and contract-ready?

legal: That wording is fine but replace ""escrow addendum"" with ""emergency-access addendum"" and add: ""Fallback requires documented customer authorization and loggable approval steps.""

nina: Also add audit note: ""Redwood emits key-usage events to tenant audit streams; customers must enable KMS-side audit logging to correlate KMS service access.""

leo: Pricing ask: customer wants to know any price delta for Dedicated with per-tenant BYOK. @sales-eng can we provide indicative numbers?

sales-eng: Indicative: one-time onboarding fee + monthly premium per cluster. I'll attach numbers after finance confirms; mark as ""indicative"" in responses.

leo: Plan: nina to finalize CAIQ text with legal edits (EOD), sales-eng to add indicative pricing, ops to confirm SR-3 gating. If customer requests a POC, propose 5-business-day Dedicated sandbox with limited dataset.

leo: Thanks, team :thumbsup: closing once CAIQ snippet + pricing are ready.
